title: Refactor token scale and elevation layering for compact & dense layouts
creator: Ava Morales
description: Update the design token system to introduce a clear, semantic scale for colors, typography, spacing/radius, and micro-elevation (shadows) that supports both default and compact/dense layout modes. This ticket captures the UX goals, token naming conventions, migration strategy, and rollout plan for components and chart libraries. The goal is to reduce visual inconsistencies, improve accessibility contrast where needed, and provide explicit token variants for compact surfaces (tables, dense lists, small controls).
acceptance_criteria: Define semantic token names (surface/interactive/sep/fg) with explicit _compact variants
Publish a typography scale with fluid steps and explicit compact sizes (h1..caption + compact: true)
Introduce micro-elevation tokens (elevation-0..elevation-4) with matching shadow layers, and compact elevation variants where blur/spread are reduced
Normalize spacing/radius tokens to a 4pt baseline with an 8pt friendly named scale and compact aliases
Documentation updated with migration guide, token JSON schema example, and component mapping table
Automated visual regression tests added for primary components and charts in both default and compact density
design_decisions: Use semantic tokens (e.g., bg.surface, bg.surface-compact, border.subtle, fg.primary) instead of implementation color names
Adopt a 4px micro-grid for spacing tokens; name tokens using scale numbers (space-1..space-12) and friendly aliases (gap-sm, gap-md, gap-lg)
Typography: provide base responsive scale using clamp() rules in CSS but also include fixed compact sizes for environments that cannot use fluid sizing
Elevation: replace ad-hoc shadows with layered tokens (elevation-x.offset, elevation-x.blur, elevation-x.spread, elevation-x.color) and provide pre-composed shadow strings for legacy components
Accessibility: adjust low-contrast semantic colors to meet WCAG AA for body text; provide high-contrast palette tokens for admin/security screens
tasks: Audit current token usage across components and charts (spreadsheet of overrides) - owner: Liam
Propose new token naming conventions and publish draft spec - owner: Ava
Create token JSON schema and sample package for designers & devs - owner: Design Systems
Update Button, Table, Card, and Chart components to consume compact tokens behind a density flag - owner: ENG runtime
Add visual tests (Percy/Chromatic) for default and compact density - owner: QA
Write migration guide and code mods for common repos (examples: console, dashboards) - owner: PM/SDR
notes: Initial audit shows inconsistent use of 'elevation' and direct shadow CSS in 18 components. Charts use color semantic tokens inconsistently (chart.series-1..6) which will need mapping. Expect 2-week parallel work between design and eng for the first release.
review_notes: PM (Jordan) requested explicit compact radii for interactive controls to prevent touch target regressions
Accessibility review: increase text-on-accent contrast for badges and status labels
Design lead: prefer semantic names to encourage runtime overrides per deployment
communication_plan: Announce token changes in #design-systems and create a changelog entry. Run a migration webinar and publish code mods. Coordinate with Growth/Support for any dashboard visuals that ship with customer-facing templates.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Breaking visual diffs in high-traffic pages - Mitigation: staged rollout with feature flag and A/B canary
Risk: Downstream repos not adopting tokens - Mitigation: provide codemods and quick-fix PRs
Risk: Accessibility regressions - Mitigation: accessibility gating on visual QA and automated contrast checks
